title: Figures 75-76: Tic Tac CFD temperature and Mach number at 400 mph
description: Two color CFD contour plots of the capsule-shaped "Tic Tac" body at 1/6 scale with numeric color legends. Captions read "Figure 75. Tic Tac Temperature at 1/6 Scale, Air Temperature 223K and 400 mph with Mixed Inlet and Subsonic Outlet" (warm wake, in K) and "Figure 76. Tic Tac Mach Number at 1/6 Scale, Air Temperature 223K and 400 mph with Mixed Inlet and Subsonic Outlet" (low-speed wake). Attachment II, page 121 of the BAASS report.
